parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description:
The ID of the file system.

*   The IDs of CPFS file systems must start with `cpfs-`. Example: cpfs-125487\*\*\*\*.
*   The IDs of CPFS for Lingjun file systems must start with `bmcpfs-`. Example: bmcpfs-0015\*\*\*\*.

parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description: The filter that is used to query dataflows.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas describe-data-flows --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --filters Value=FsetIds Key=FsetIds --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cmNlU0000mVzJjE1MTI2NjY4NzY5MTAzOTEmMiZORnI4NDhVeEtrUT0= --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun nas DescribeDataFlows --region cn-hangzhou --Filters.1.Key FsetIds --NextToken 'TGlzdFJlc291cmNlU0000mVzJjE1MTI2NjY4NzY5MTAzOTEmMiZORnI4NDhVeEtrUT0=' --MaxResults 20 --Filters.1.Value FsetIds --FileSystemId 'cpfs-099394bd928c0000'
